sections.thesis: Treasuries rallied as Meta's spending plans revived worries about the debt-funded AI boom and traders rushed into haven assets.

sentences.text: Treasuries rallied as Meta's spending plans revived worries about the debt-funded AI boom and traders rushed into haven assets.
Ten-year yields fell 0.16 percentage points to just below 5 per cent, the best one-day performance since 2024.
A Barclays strategist said the rally was about potential cracks in the AI trade, not economic data.

sections.thesis: The yen strengthened against the dollar after Japan's inflation report, with USD/JPY near 156.25 in early Asian trading.

sentences.text: The yen strengthened against the dollar after Japan's inflation report, with USD/JPY near 156.25 in early Asian trading.
National CPI rose 2.1% from a year earlier in September versus 1.9% prior, while the measure excluding fresh food and energy climbed 2.4%.
A gauge of the dollar edged 0.1% lower, its third straight daily fall.

sections.thesis: Meta led a sharp US tech sell-off after its spending plans reignited concerns about the debt-fuelled AI build-out.

sentences.text: Meta led a sharp US tech sell-off after its spending plans reignited concerns about the debt-fuelled AI build-out.
Its shares tumbled 7 per cent after it forecast needing to raise "hundreds of billions of dollars" over several years, stripping about $124bn from its value.
The Nasdaq 100 slid 2.9 per cent, the S&P 500 dropped 1.2 per cent and the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell almost 7 per cent.

sections.thesis: Oil rose on Friday as Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concerns of further disruption to Middle East supplies.

sentences.text: Oil rose on Friday as Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concerns of further disruption to Middle East supplies.
Brent climbed $1.30 to $114.47 a barrel as of 0639 GMT, after settling on Thursday at its highest since May 4.
Gold fell to its lowest in more than two months near $4,025 as the oil surge stoked worries about an energy-driven inflation shock.
